scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @cacp/protocol build && corepack pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=4 test:unit
scripts.test:coverage: corepack pnpm --filter @cacp/protocol build && corepack pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=2 test:coverage
scripts.dev:server: corepack pnpm --filter @cacp/protocol build && corepack pnpm --filter @cacp/server dev
scripts.dev:web: corepack pnpm --filter @cacp/protocol build && corepack pnpm --filter @cacp/web dev
scripts.dev:adapter: corepack pnpm --filter @cacp/protocol build && corepack pnpm --filter @cacp/cli-adapter dev ../../docs/examples/claude-code-agent.json
scripts.validate: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build
